content.thinking:
The product page is an async server component that awaits `getInventory()` which calls `connection()` (opts into dynamic rendering) and does random computation. The entire page blocks on this data fetch before anything renders.

The fix is to use a Suspense boundary so the title ("Premium Widget") renders immediately while the inventory data loads. We can split the inventory fetching into a separate component wrapped in Suspense.

content.text: The product page is a single async component — the entire page (including the title) blocks on `getInventory()` before anything is sent to the browser. The fix is to stream the page by wrapping the dynamic inventory data in a `<Suspense>` boundary so the title renders immediately.
